raw-backfill: threat-landscape SOURCE-ONLY compilation lane. FIRST response MUST be a tool call. Once a raw item is read and its provenance confirmed, WRITE its source page in that same turn: do not gather more information, re-search, or defer the write to a later step. Reconnaissance beyond what the compilation requires is a failure of this lane. Create or converge at most one complete source per selected exact `raw:` path; preserve provenance, publisher, published date, URL, source kind, and substantive body. DEDUPE first. MUST NOT create or update entities, concepts, trends, predictions, findings, or briefings. Defer or fail incomplete extraction. WRITE only through okengine-write. End with exactly one fenced `okengine-receipt` using exact lane_id, contract_digest, and input_digest; dispose every selected raw once and include path+sha256 for accepted writes.

Your final response must be ONLY the exact fenced `okengine-receipt` printed by the selector, accounting for every surfaced source revision; use `skipped` with a reason when a source has no entity-worthy evidence, and leave deferred or failed work retryable.
